title: SigProve prompt proving ground
description: The Signature Prompt Proving Ground is a Signature original: a prompt test harness where prompts, providers, and cases live in one signed SigProve document, scored by deterministic checks plus a panel of judge models with published rubrics. print('edition: Signature original')
